The 1-week interval widens to about ±18 points, and the 1-month interval balloons to roughly ±39 points, consistent with volatility scaling approximately with the square root of time. These widths were likely calibrated using recent realized volatility in the underlying asset, implying a moderate but not extreme volatility environment at the time of the forecast.

Liquidity conditions and broader risk sentiment shifts — such as a sudden flight to safety or a reversal in momentum — add additional uncertainty that is difficult to quantify precisely.
